[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:388YE Summer]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Bloodcrow Rasp, Senator for Skarsind, Seconded: Rane Shardbearer, Senator for Kallavesa">To invest in the docks of Beoraidh (commission an edifice) so that the fleet owners of the Empire can engage in Prosperous trade with the port and raise 10 thrones a season in tariffs and tax. Seeking a disbursement of funds for 75 thrones
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs an [[edifice]] in Beoraidh, Mareave
* Passed at 75 thrones
* 75 thrones disbursed to Senator for Skarsind
* More information can be found in the '''[[Each_age_a_lens#Investment_of_Sea|Each ages a lens]]''' wind of fortune

==Date==
* Summer 388YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 30 wains of weirwood
* 90 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Invest_in_Beoraidh_Docks}}
==Outcome==
Once complete, the docks will have the following effects: 
* Opens the port of Beoraidh to Imperial fleet captains
* Raises taxation in Mareave by three thrones
* Raises taxes from tariffs by seven thrones
